g.text: Matched streaming text and virtualized-list UI
Linux / Mesa llvmpipe · LP_NUM_THREADS=4 per pool · 3 repeats per mode
Bars: medians. Whiskers: observed min–max, not confidence intervals.
15 seconds sampled after 5 seconds warmup; shared host. Logical updates ≠ presented frames.
